body_html:
How to think about it

We get water from rain, rivers, lakes, ponds, wells, hand pumps and taps. All plants and animals need water, and we use it for drinking, cooking, bathing, washing and farming. Most of the Earth's water is salty sea water, so clean fresh water is precious.

Dirty water can cause diseases such as diarrhoea, so we boil or filter water and keep it covered. We save water by closing taps, fixing leaks, using buckets instead of hoses and collecting rainwater.

Example

A tap leaks 2 litres every hour. In 5 hours?

2 × 5

Answer: 10 litres

Example

Brushing with the tap running is…

water flows away unused

Answer: wasting water

Common mistakes

  • Thinking water never runs out.
  • Drinking water from an uncovered pot.
  • Thinking a few drops do not matter.
